title: Phonological contrast (0.2)
description: One JSONL line per perceptual contrast set (minimal pair or high-variability group, K-10). Language-neutral: the engine plays one item and asks which was heard; it never interprets the phonology itself. Audio is media-first (`media/<id>-<item-index>.wav`) with model-output synthesis fallback.

feature_id.description: The phonology feature this contrast trains (a phonotactics/prosody entry id from language/phonology.yaml).

items.description: The contrast members. All are played and offered as choices; the set IS the answer space.

text.description: Canonical written form; also the TTS input when no licensed recording exists.

reading.description: Optional reading shown only after grading (never during the listening attempt).

gloss.description: Optional meaning shown only after grading.

description.description: What contrast is being trained, for the learner-facing intro.

production.description: Optional target for PRODUCTION scoring (speaking back the contrast). Language-neutral: the engine reads a declared number and never infers the phonology. Absent means the feature cannot score production without a reference recording. The value is authored by the pack maintainer (e.g. derived from mora counts for Japanese, or from the language's own phonology) and is uncalibrated until SPEECH-007.

measure.description: Which production measurement the target anchors. The engine maps this selector to an interpreter; new contrasts/languages add measures without engine phonology.

expected_ratio.description: Target long/short whole-word voiced-duration ratio for a correct production (e.g. mora-count ratio: obasan 4 morae vs obaasan 5 morae = 1.25).

tolerance_low.description: Below expected_ratio*tolerance_low => 'shorter'. Must be high enough that a no-contrast production (ratio ~1.0) is not read as 'close'.
